releases.name: Anka Native 0.3.0
releases.body:
Anka Native 0.3.0 draws the tree canopies, plants and the arch beside Link's door that 0.2.2 left out, adds a 3D resolution setting, a faster Prepare on the phone and three new languages.
It is still slow: Kokiri Forest runs at about 14 fps on our test phone, and frames are slower than in 0.2.2 where the new content is on screen. The change for the Adreno 840 hang (#5) is untested because we have no Adreno 840.

"Tested on the phone" below means our only test phone: POCO F8 Pro (Adreno 830, 12 GB, Android 16 / HyperOS). "Tests only" means automated tests or a computer, not a phone.

### What is new

- **Mesh-drawn content is now drawn.** Kokiri Forest's tree canopies, grass, ferns, flowers and the arch beside Link's door, and the Deku Tree upper floor's floor that was invisible ([#6](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/issues/6)). 0.2.2 skipped these draws on Turnip drivers. Your pack gets the needed shaders through an automatic update (see *After updating*). Tested on the phone with Anka Turnip: no draws skipped in Kokiri Forest and the Deku Tree's upper floor. Not tested on an Adreno 7xx, and not with Qualcomm's own driver.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.2.2
releases.body:
### Security fix

- **The launcher no longer takes control commands from other apps** ([#7](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/issues/7)).
  - Before this release, any app on the phone could ask Anka Native's launcher to install or pick a GPU driver, add a game, start Prepare, or export or import a pack. These are commands meant for testing over adb.
  - The app now ignores them and shows a short message, unless you turn on **Settings › ADB control (debug)**. That switch is off by default and asks before it turns on. Turn it on only while you use adb.
  - Starting a game from a frontend works as before.

Everything else is as in [0.2.1](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/releases/tag/v0.2.1). The full list of changes is in [CHANGELOG_ANKA_NATIVE.md](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/blob/main/CHANGELOG_ANKA_NATIVE.md).

### Files

- `anka-native-0.2.2.apk`: the app (`dev.ankanative.android`), signed with the release key. Certificate SHA-256: `4d7443354f53a0aef11bc4df1a34ff3fc5bd6d748bbeb76fd78c80a6841f3bb0`. It installs over earlier versions and keeps your saves.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: checksum of the APK

releases.name: Anka Native 0.2.1
releases.body:
### Fixes

- **Prepare on the phone stopped at the end for Ocarina of Time** ([#3](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/issues/3)): "76 of 42346 shaders did not build: no library written".

  The same 76 shaders don't build on a computer either, and the game runs without them. Ocarina of Time's profile was missing the list that tells the phone which shaders those are, so the phone counted them as failures. 0.2.1 adds the list.

  Checked on a computer with the phone's rule: the library is now written, byte for byte the one a computer makes.

  **If your Prepare stopped with this message:** update to 0.2.1, open the game's card and tap **Retry**. The shaders already translated are kept, so it only tries the 76 again and then writes the library.

### New

- **Prepare on a computer on Windows** too, besides Linux and the Mac. Setup: [android/README.md](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/blob/main/android/README.md#the-environment).
- **[Discussions](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/discussions)** are open. Tell us how it runs on your phone in the [device reports](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/discussions/1) thread.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.2.0
releases.body:
**Prepare on the phone (experimental).** The app can now make a game's pack from your dump on the phone itself. You no longer need a computer.

### How

Copy your dump (or `.nup`) to the phone, open **Anka Native**, tap **Add game**, pick the dump and tap **Prepare**. The app does three things in the background, with a notification:

1. It rewrites the game's code.
2. It scans the game's files for shaders.
3. It translates the shaders.

When it is done, the game's card says Ready.

- **Keep the phone on a charger.** For Ocarina of Time, preparing takes about 3 hours and uses the CPU fully.
- If a step fails, the card says why. Its log is in `<title ID>-work/ondevice/logs` next to the dump. Preparing on a computer still works as before.

### What was tested

On a POCO F8 Pro with Ocarina of Time:

- **Code rewrite:** worked, about 3 minutes.
- **Shader scan:** worked, about 35 minutes for the game's 186,583 files. It found 42,346 shaders, as many as on a computer.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.1.1
releases.body:
A fix for 0.1.0: **Prepare on the phone looked done but made nothing to play.**

0.1.0 was built without the on-phone packer. Its Prepare ran a simulated engine: the progress finished, but the pack it made was an empty placeholder with no game code and no shaders, so Play could not start the game.

### What changed

- Without the on-phone packer, the app no longer offers Prepare. Home and the game's card now say to prepare the game on a computer (the README's [Install](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative#install) steps) and to pick that pack.
- A placeholder pack left by 0.1.0 is no longer shown as ready: the card says "No pack", and Play explains why.

Preparing on the phone itself is being worked on for a later release.

Everything else is as in [0.1.0](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/releases/tag/v0.1.0): your own dump is needed, the driver is [Anka Turnip 1.0.0](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaTurnip/releases/tag/v1.0.0), and the RAM saver is recommended below 16 GB of RAM. Tested only on a POCO F8 Pro with Ocarina of Time.

releases.name: v0.3.9: 2-player local controller support, Android 10 & cubemap fixes
releases.body:
## Persona 4 Arena Ultimax Android Recomp v0.3.9

### Español
- **Soporte para 2 mandos locales en Android:** Jugador 1 y Jugador 2 independientes por `InputDevice` ID (`read_pad` / `read_pad2`) con detección automática de conexión/desconexión vía JNI.
- **Fix Android 10 (API 29):** Guard para `InsetsController` evitando cierres en dispositivos Android 10 con fallback seguro al modo inmersivo clásico.
- **Diagonales en mando físico y reflejos:** Zona muerta radial 2D para alcanzar el 100% en diagonales y `VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT` en texturas `2D_ARRAY` cuadradas de `6n` capas.

---

### English
- **2-player local controller support on Android:** Independent P1/P2 mapping by `InputDevice` ID (`read_pad` / `read_pad2`) with automatic connect/disconnect tracking.
- **Android 10 (API 29) crash fix:** Guarded `InsetsController` behind API >= 30 with safe legacy immersive fallback.
- **Physical stick diagonals & cubemaps:** 2D radial deadzone for full 100% diagonal reach and `VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT` on square `6n`-layer `2D_ARRAY` images.

releases.name: v0.3.7: Battle cut-ins & two-sided stencil rendering fix
releases.body:
## Persona 4 Arena Ultimax for Android v0.3.7

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras
- **Battle Cut-ins Missing Fixed (Fixes #4):**
  Fixed missing special move, super attack, and Persona summon cut-in portraits and animations in battle.
  - Implemented proper two-sided stencil dynamic state (reference, compare mask, and write mask).
  - Added support for \VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT\ and \VK_FORMAT_D16_UNORM_S8_UINT\ in dynamic rendering pipelines, enabling stencil writes on all mobile GPUs.
  - Added state invalidation on pass end (\g_bound = Bound{}\) so dynamic stencil state is correctly bound in every render pass.
  *Se corrigió la ausencia de los cut-ins de personajes, ataques especiales e invocaciones de Persona en combate. Se reparó el estado dinámico de stencil de doble cara, el soporte para formatos D24S8/D16S8 en Dynamic Rendering y la invalidación de estado al terminar pases.*

Install over the previous version; your saves and data stay. / Instálalo encima de la versión anterior; tus partidas y datos se mantienen.

releases.name: xbased 1.2.16
releases.body:
## 1.2.16 (2026-11)

### Fixes
- Psi-Ops: The Mindgate Conspiracy (Europe) went to a black screen after the
  opening cinematics of a new game, in every language (#444). The game frees
  its text file as a new game starts and loads it again into a block of the
  same size, and it keeps using a pointer into the old block, so it needs
  that block back at the same address. Small blocks the emulator's kernel
  made in between took that spot. They now fill a gap instead, the block
  comes back where it was and the game goes on into the first level.
- Chase: Hollywood Stunt Driver could crash as its first loading screen came
  up when its cache drive had last been used by another game. After the
  drive was formatted the emulator still reported the other game's files as
  using the space, so the game found no room and no file of its own to
  delete. A format and a deleted file now show in the free space at once.
- Alter Echo: the movie at the start of a new game stayed on its first
  frame while its sound played, since 1.2.0 (#197). The movie's picture sits
  in the memory of an older frame, and the emulator kept the copy it made

releases.name: xbased 1.2.15
releases.body:
## 1.2.15 (2026-11)

### Performance
- Games that read the picture they are drawing as a texture, as Riddick's
  lighting does about 150 times a frame, no longer copy the whole picture
  before each of those draws. The picture is read where it is drawn. The
  copies weigh most on cards with little memory speed: in Escape from
  Butcher Bay a GTX 1050 at 2x dropped to 35-50 fps, and a fast card at 6x
  went from 50 to 60 fps in the same scene (#435).

### Fixes
- Chronicles of Riddick froze a few seconds into a new game, and in some
  later chapters, on slower graphics cards since 1.2.14. The emulator let a
  game run further ahead of the graphics card than an Xbox does, and Riddick
  ended up with more visibility tests waiting than it has room for. Now a
  game is at most a frame ahead of what the card has drawn, as on the
  console. A card that keeps up never waits (#435).
- Blade II: the characters' shadows were pale pink streaks on the street
  again, since 1.2.0 (#287). When a vertex program writes no fog, the Xbox's
  graphics chip uses the fog its earlier vertices left (it keeps the last 6),
  and xbased gave those vertices no fog distance, so the city's haze coloured

releases.name: xbased 1.2.14
releases.body:
## 1.2.14 (2026-11)

### Performance
- Scenes made of many small pieces run much faster. A game that draws lots
  of small triangle strips one after another has them drawn as one, and each
  draw uploads only the shader constants it uses. 007 Everything or
  Nothing's first level, looking at the courtyard, went from 38 to about 135
  fps uncapped on a fast PC, and at Original it now holds 30 where it
  dropped to 13 (#429).
- Interrupts reach the emulated CPU with a single memory write instead of a
  call into Windows, which made every game's interrupts cheaper.
- Uncapped games that show a frame every second vblank no longer wait on
  Windows' timer between the two, which can't wait less than half a
  millisecond.
- Unlocked on a 120 Hz or faster display (VRR or not): a frame that comes
  late is shown at once instead of waiting for the display's next refresh.

### Fixes
- Frame rate limit: Spyro A Hero's Tail ran at 64.5 fps at Up to 60. The
  limit followed a vsync grid that slowly moved back, and the display's
  refresh period could be measured as a fraction of the real one. Frames are
  now counted against the display's refreshes (#430).

releases.name: xbased 1.2.13
releases.body:
## 1.2.13 (2026-11)

A cleanup and optimization release: the same emulator, with less code.

### Changes
- The code is cleaned of everything that no longer served: the paths for
  platforms xbased doesn't run on, the workarounds for graphics drivers no PC
  has, old files, and functions nothing called any more. About 8,000 lines of
  code less, the executable a little smaller, and nothing that changes how
  games run.
- Depth buffers are created only with the uses they have, which leaves the
  driver more room to compress them.
- The debug switches (props.ini) are read by one piece of code on Windows and
  Linux alike.
- The source repository is tidier: README, BUILDING and CHANGELOG at its root,
  the build steps in one place, and every library built in listed with its
  license.

### Fixes
- The Linux build compiles without warnings on Ubuntu 22.04 (a few
  declarations its C library doesn't have).

releases.name: xbased 1.2.12
releases.body:
## 1.2.12 (2026-11)

### New
- Downsampling (Settings > Video > Downsampling: Off, 1x, 2x, 4x): the game
  is drawn at the internal resolution, then the picture is averaged down to
  the console's own resolution, or twice or four times it, before it's scaled
  to your screen. Smooth edges with the original look. It needs an internal
  resolution above the size chosen, and works with FXAA, FSR and the CRT look
  (#427).

### Fixes
- Fable The Lost Chapters: the hero's hair could turn into streaks up close
  after some area loads, until the next restart. The game builds the hero's
  look into a cache on the hard disk at each load, and a piece of it drawn
  where a swizzled texture of the same size had been landed in the wrong
  pixel order (#380).
- Savestates: a state made from a .chd loads from an .iso of the same dump
  and the other way round, and a state that is refused says why in the log.
- Frame rate limit: with the GPU maxed out (a high internal resolution on a
  laptop) the frame rate could drift above the limit, 64 fps at Up to 60 in
  Crash Bandicoot The Wrath of Cortex. The moments the presenter picks frames

Back in the [FEX-2510](/FEX-2510) release we completely removed a **FEXLoader** binary with a deprecation of the **FEXInterpreter** binary, renaming it to
just **FEX**. We kept the FEXInterpreter binary around for a while because downstream projects had hardcoded the binary in their scripts and we wanted to give
some time for them to migrate. After nearly a year we're hoping that everyone has migrated to the new binary name. If your project is still using the
old binary name then we recommend fix them!

releases.name: Pokemon Legends Arceus Android First Release
releases.body:
# Arceus Recomp for Android — v1.0 

Android port of **PokeL-ARecomp**, the static recompilation of *Pokémon Legends: Arceus*. Tested on the AYN Odin 3 (Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830).

> ⚠️ This repository **does not include the game, keys or game code**. Every player uses their own legal copy.

## ✨ What's new

### Performance and heat
- **60 fps at 60 Hz with 100% resolution.**
- **Much less heat:** CPU went from ~84 °C to ~52 °C and the fan is barely audible.
- **CPU cores:** the game uses 4 cores and leaves the rest free. You can pick All / 4 / 2.
- **Clock speeds:** the port tells Android how long each frame really takes, on the CPU and the GPU. The CPU no longer sits at max clock, and the GPU clocks up when it needs to.
- **Less data copying:** GPU constants are read straight from shared memory, so about 80% less data is copied per frame.

releases.name: 1.0.0 Risshun
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这是 `1.0.0` 首个正式版。电脑端改用系统 WebView2 并提供安装包与便携模式，双端新增游戏封面、手动备份与按次选择写入前备份，并从本版本起保持 `1.x` 期间的设置与备份兼容。

## 升级说明

> [!CAUTION]
> **从 `0.x` 升级必须重新配置；Android 必须先卸载再安装。**
> - **Android 端**：本版本更换了应用签名密钥，无法直接覆盖安装 `0.x` 版本，请**先卸载旧版再安装 `1.0.0`**。卸载会一并删除游戏设置、目录授权和 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/` 下的备份，升级前请先将需要保留的备份复制到其他位置，或先恢复所需存档。
> - **Windows 端**：配置与数据改存至新目录（配置位于 `%APPDATA%\galgame-savedata-sync\`，游戏、设备和备份默认位于 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\galgame-savedata-sync\`），**不迁移 `0.x` 测试版的数据**，升级后需要重新添加游戏、连接设备并关联。原 `0.x` 版本位于 `%APPDATA%\存档同步\` 的文件不会被删除，需要时可手动取回或清理。

- **两端必须一起升级**：通信协议与能力版本已更新，旧版设备会显示为版本不同，无法连接或传输。
- **从 `1.0.0` 起保持数据与备份兼容**：此后 `1.x` 版本升级将保留游戏配置、设备关联与备份，且 `1.0.0` 起写入的备份可在整个 `1.x` 内列出和恢复；两台设备需处于同一主次版本（例如均为 `1.0.x`）才能连接。若用旧版应用打开由更新版本写入的数据，应用会保持数据不变并提示安装最新版本后再打开。
- **Windows 分发包调整**：提供 `SavedataSync-1.0.0-Setup-x64.exe` 安装包（支持只为当前用户或所有用户安装，缺少 WebView2 时自动下载安装）和 `SavedataSync-1.0.0-Portable-x64.zip` 免安装版（在 `SavedataSync.exe` 同级目录新建 `portable_data` 文件夹可启用便携模式，数据随程序保存）。

## 新功能

- **游戏封面**：游戏卡片可显示竖版封面。在“游戏设置”的“封面”一行中，支持从 VNDB、NextMoe、Bangumi 和 Steam 在线搜索封面（NextMoe 可先选作品再选封面），也支持从本机选取图片或移除封面；从对端导入游戏时，会一并取回对方已设置的封面。

releases.name: 0.5.0 Interconnected Devices
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版起，同一网络内的任意两台设备都能互相连接、互传存档：电脑可以连接另一台电脑，Android 也能开启本机服务，让电脑或其他手机连进来。连接后两端都能发起传输。

## 升级说明

> [!CAUTION]
> **升级后需要重新设置游戏和设备。** 配置格式已变更，读不了 0.4.0 的配置，覆盖安装后应用会报配置错误。
> 电脑端删除 `%APPDATA%\存档同步\game-library.json`；Android 清除应用数据，或卸载后重新安装。之后重新添加游戏、连接设备并关联。
> Android 清除应用数据或卸载会一并删除 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/` 下的备份，需要保留时先把这个文件夹复制到其他位置。

- **两端必须一起升级**：通信协议与 0.4.0 不兼容，旧版设备会显示为版本不同，无法连接。
- **写入前备份改为默认关闭**：被覆盖的文件默认不保留，需要备份时在“设置”中开启。关闭备份时开始传输不再弹出确认。

## 新功能

- **电脑连接其他设备**：电脑的设备页会搜索附近的设备，也可以手动输入地址连接，两台电脑之间可以互传存档。已保存的设备在原地址连不上时，会按设备查找 5 秒并改用新地址。
- **Android 本机服务**：在设备页点击“启动本机服务”后显示地址和连接二维码，电脑和其他手机可以连进这台手机。服务由常驻通知保持，应用切到后台后仍能被连接、接收传输，也可以从通知停止。服务停止时可以换端口。
- **任意一端发起传输**：连接后两端都能发起传输并选择方向，包括两台 Android 之间。每台设备同一时间只连接一台设备。
- **对方自动打开传输详情**：传输开始时，另一端也会切到这次传输的详情页。
- **修改日期提示**：Android 未开启“直接读写文件”、计划里又有文件要写入手机时，计划页或传输详情会显示黄色提示，可以直接去开启权限。
- **导入游戏默认用对方的游戏名**：从另一端导入游戏时，名称默认填对方设备上的游戏名。

## 修复与改进

- Android 未开启“直接读写文件”时，电脑向手机覆盖大量文件不再随文件数成倍变慢。以前覆盖约 500 个文件、97 MiB 需要近 8 分钟。
- 附近的设备停止服务后，约 10 秒内从“附近的设备”列表消失。以前会一直显示，点“连接”才失败。
- 本机服务的端口被占用时，提示换一个端口后重试；Android 停止本机服务后马上再开启不再失败。
- 和文件无关的程序内部错误改为提示“应用内部出错，请重试；仍然失败时重启应用”，不再提示读写文件失败。

releases.name: 0.4.0 Faster Sync
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版主要提速：比较只看文件大小和修改日期，不再逐个计算哈希；内容边打包边发送、边收边解包，接收端的备份与传输同时进行。Android 授予“所有文件访问权限”后直接读写存档目录，扫描、备份和写入都快很多。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.1，设备、游戏和备份设置都会保留。备份设置格式已升级，旧版应用读不了，不支持降级。
- **两端必须一起升级**：比较和传输协议与 0.3.x 不兼容，一端是旧版时会在开始传输前提示更新两端。
- **Android 最低版本提高到 Android 11。**

## 新功能

- **按大小和修改日期比较**：两端文件大小相同、修改日期相差不超过 2 秒即视为相同，扫描只列目录，不再读取文件内容计算 SHA-256。写入后目标文件的修改日期设为来源的修改日期，下次比较显示相同。
- **流式传输**：发送端直接把文件打包进网络流，接收端边收边解包，本机不再生成快照或压缩包。数据不完整或中途断开时目标不变。
- **备份与传输并行**：接收端登记任务后马上开始备份，同时接收内容，备份完成且内容收齐后再写入。进度分为备份、传输、写入三段。
- **备份阶段显示百分比**：两端界面和 Android 通知在备份时都显示进度，不再一直转圈。
- **Android 所有文件访问权限**：授权后游戏目录直接按路径读写，不经 SAF。设置页显示授权状态并可跳到系统授权页，首次添加游戏后会提示一次；未授权时照常经 SAF 读写。

## 修复与改进

- 备份和写入去掉多余的重读、逐文件 fsync 和反复列目录，Android 扫描、备份和打包时同时打开多个文件。约 500 个文件、100 MiB 的存档目录，两端备份从约 5 分钟降到数秒。
- 备份按游戏归组：重新选择游戏目录后，旧目录的备份照常列出、参与轮换，也能恢复到当前目录。
- “重新扫描”沿用上次传输的方向，不再回到默认的电脑传移动端。
- 一端取消传输时两端都记为已取消，另一端不再显示“传输失败：网络连接中断”。
- 手机上传途中断网时两端都按网络中断结束，不再报“请求内容无效”或被电脑记为用户取消。
- 手机作为发送端时可以看到电脑的备份进度，不再一直显示“正在备份 0%”。
- 手机发送途中断网或应用被结束时，电脑不再卡住到 30 分钟期限才能开始新的比较和传输。
- 对方存档目录改名后又改回，刷新即可重新比较，不用断开重连。
- 移动端刚连上时连点“连接”不再断开刚建立的连接。
- 电脑写入途中被强制结束留下的临时文件，比较时跳过，下次写入时清理。
- 任务结果和进度文案更准确：文件、文件夹和删除分开计数；取消时没执行的文件不再算失败；结果待确认时不再显示“部分完成”；等待对方设备时有单独说明；错误写明出错的是哪一端。

## Added NetPlay Public Rooms

Until now, NetPlay worked over the internet with no account, no relay, and no service to trust. The one thing it could not do was find you an opponent: you still had to know someone already, and swap an IP address with them by hand.

**Public Rooms** is that missing half. It's an optional board where hosts advertise the game they are hosting, so anyone with the same ROM can tap it and connect.

What it is *not* is a relay. The board introduces two players and then steps out of the way — the match still runs directly between the two devices, exactly as it did before, and nothing about it passes through any server of mine. 

### On the board

* **Room codes.** Every room gets a short code you can pass to a friend. 
* **PIN rooms.** Tick *Require PIN* and the room still appears, marked as protected, but only the people you told can get in. The PIN itself never reaches the server — only a hash of it does.
* **A color-coded connection forecast.** Green, amber, or red per room, based on what STUN actually measured about both routers rather than a guess. Two symmetric NATs with no way through show red and refuse the join.

This release introduces **NetPlay**: play the same game together over Wi-Fi or the internet, built from scratch as a native part of MAME4droid rather than bolted on.

# Heroes V for Android 0.8.2-dev

Includes Heroes V 1.6, Hammers of Fate 2.1, and Tribes of the East 3.1. Requires Android 8.0 or later, an ARM64 device, and the original PC game files. Android version code **15**.

## Startup and launcher

- Added **3D main menu** and **Fast main menu** options. Turn off the 3D background to use a solid color, or enable fast startup to use the menu while the 3D scene loads between frames. Both options take effect on the next launch.
- Selecting a parent folder containing GOG Gold and Tribes of the East can set up all three editions in one step. The launcher keeps existing working game paths.
- ZIP imports now check the MD5 when the checksum is included in the archive filename and report mismatches.
- The launcher adapts to wide windows with a two-column layout and accepts custom Vulkan drivers in ZIP or `.so` format.
- On Xiaomi HyperOS, the launcher offers a shortcut to Game Turbo before autostart. The tip can be dismissed and reopened from About.

## Touch controls and interface

- Interface scale is now a dropdown from **50% to 200%** in **25%** steps. A value saved by the old slider stays in effect until you select a new value.

releases.name: Heroes V v0.8-dev
releases.body:
Speeds up AI turns and dense OpenGL ES map views, improves graphics and saves, and restores optional DXVK/Turnip rendering. One APK includes Heroes V 1.6, Hammers of Fate 2.1 and Tribes of the East 3.1.

Android version `0.8-dev` / code `13`, signed with the existing APK update certificate.

Changes since 0.7-dev:

- Enable **Fast AI turn** by default. AI estimates avoid repeatedly serializing and checksumming the map's object-name table during rollbacks. Restored entries are checked; a mismatch disables the shortcut for the process. The original path is used after the first network socket opens. Find the switch under **Settings > Additional > Controls**, between Split zones and Order confirmation. This speeds up calculations, not hero animations or AI difficulty.
- Grow the OpenGL ES upload ring when consecutive frames outgrow it, avoiding repeated per-draw allocations in dense adventure views.
- Move common DLL code into `libhomm5_common.so`, saving about 43 MB after all three engines have been unpacked. Add native vertex, lighting, battle-grid and byte-compatible deflate paths.

releases.name: Heroes V v0.7-dev
releases.body:
Adds native battle route previews, optional order confirmation and contextual alternative-attack tips, and fixes save-list refresh and repeated streaming audio. One APK includes Heroes V 1.6, Hammers of Fate 2.1 and Tribes of the East 3.1.

Android version `0.7-dev` / code `12`; signed with the existing APK update certificate.

Changes since 0.6-dev:

- Preview movement paths and destination cells before issuing a battle order. Paths follow the original prepared command, preserving obstacle detours, terrain height and flight paths. Strike and Return shows separate outgoing and returning lanes. Route previews are enabled by default and work independently of confirmation.
- Add optional battle order confirmation. Taps and gestures select movement, melee attacks, shots or spells; a separate button above the right-side action panel executes the selected order. Wait and Defend retain their immediate buttons. Confirmation is disabled by default.

- On-screen controls with adjustable transparency, vibration feedback and multi-key support.
- Global button mapping for keyboards and wired/Bluetooth controllers, including sticks and triggers.

releases.body:
## v11.5 摘要

**批量 / 扫描导入** — 导入向导第一步新增「批量扫描导入（多选）」：选一个目录（例如 Download），用 SAF 扫出候选——顶层带 `.exe` / `.rpy` / `.rpyc` / `.xp3` / `.rpa` / `.ypf` / `.wolf` / `.rgssad` / `.nsa` 之一，或是 Ren'Py 的 `game/` 目录；套娃目录只下探一层，跳过隐藏目录与运行时目录。勾选后**串行**导入，每条独立汇报「等待 / 复制中 / 导入中 / 已导入 / 失败」，失败项复用单条导入的回滚（删已建容器根目录 + 清暂存）。批量**不**自动拉起内置引擎，导完统一回游戏库自己点。

**分类过滤由「单选」升级为「三维组合」** — 引擎 + 品类 + 标签可同时生效（AND），同一维度再点一次取消；筛空时空态文案改为「没有匹配的游戏」。「继续游玩」改为按最后启动时间倒序且只收真启动过的（`lastPlayedAt > 0`）——此前是「列表前 3 个」，名不副实；没玩过任何游戏时整段隐藏。

**封面（提取修复 + 用户自定义）** — ①`BitmapFactory` 解不了 PE 资源里的原始 DIB，所以卡片封面一直是占位图；新增 `IconCodec` 兜底（补 14 字节 `BITMAPFILEHEADER`、`biHeight` 减半剥掉 AND 掩码层、按 8bpp 调色板算偏移），组内候选按字节数降序逐个重试——真机上那款 Unity 游戏的 exe 图标首次正常显示。②详情页「维护 → 封面」可**从相册选图**或**恢复自动**，优先级 自定义 > 目录图 > exe 图标；选图先落 `.tmp` 并实际解码一次，解不开的不落盘。③修「换完封面回列表仍显示占位图」：解码完成前同一位置可能已被重绑到另一个 View，旧逻辑只贴给回调持有者；现在解码完成后让列表按缓存位图重画一次。

**UI 修正（真机实测出来的）** — 多选条加「品类 / 标签」后，六个动作把「已选 N 项」挤成 0 宽、「完成」被截断：标签简化为「删除 / 移除」、收紧边距、计数给最小宽度，全部回到一行内。「彻底删除 / 仅移除」确认弹窗从**只报数量**改为**列出游戏名**，并写明原生游戏的收纳副本同样会被删（真机复验时因只报数量误删过一批，当场从仍在的源目录重新导入恢复）。

releases.name: v11.4
releases.body:
## v11.4 摘要

**导入重做** — 第一步从「手输路径」换成系统文件夹选择器（`ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE` + persistable 授权），授权跟目录走、不随卸载重装重置；所选目录先复制进应用私有暂存（带进度、失败清半成品、可用空间 <128MB 硬失败、6h 残骸清扫）再走原管线。

**导入假成功链（真机事故 D1–D5）** — 重装后「所有文件访问」被系统重置时 `listFiles()` 为 null，旧行为一路「成功」到启动才报「启动文件缺失」：现 step0 fail-fast 并带用户去授权页。同批修复：解压套娃目录归一（`resolveGameRoot`，JVM 回归 E15–E21）、库条目回填标题/引擎、CJK 目录名塌缩改附哈希后缀、容器名恒等 `galgame-<gameId>`（避让上移到 id 派生）、导入失败回滚已建容器、复制完成无 exe 当场告警、重复导入先确认。

**游戏库分类** — 顶部 chips 单选过滤：引擎自动归类（多于一种才出现）、预置内容品类（视觉小说 / 文字冒险 / 其他）、自定义标签；长按多选后「品类 / 标签」可一次给多张卡归类，标签可内联新建。

**数据安全三件** — ①「彻底删除」补删 `files/galgame-native` 收纳副本（此前数 GB 静默泄漏）并校验结果；②索引改 `.tmp`+`fsync`+rename 原子写，解析失败先隔离 `.corrupt-<ts>` 再重建；③存档管理器拒绝空 gameId（跨游戏串档），便携存档「先搬后链」改为合并不完整就不删源、链接失败把档拷回、同名冲突留 `.bak`。

**运维事实（重要）** — 卸载重装 / 清数据会重置全部文件权限（含「所有文件访问」），ColorOS/Android 16 上 shell 无法代授，只能用户手动开；新的导入流程不依赖该权限。

**真机验收** — RMX5010 / Adreno 830 / Android 16，release 包 11.4：选择器全链路（Download → 游戏目录 → 使用此文件夹）→ 检测 UNITY / 5 个文件 → 导入 → 单卡启动 → 标题菜单 → 正片连续推进对白 100s+；分类三条链路（品类/标签/引擎 chips，筛选取值 1/1/2）；把索引写成非法 JSON 后改一次分类 → 旧文件留档、新索引字段正确；注入 2MB 收纳副本后彻底删除 → 目录归空。

releases.name: v11.3
releases.body:
## v11.3 摘要

**界面** — Swiss 单首页 IA 与全站视觉重构：内页与游戏内 UI 收进同一套视觉语言；明暗双档走同一套主题 token（`values-night` 反相，状态栏图标随档位切换）；「设置 → 输入控制」从死路接成真入口；运行环境可管理（详情 / 重新注入语言字体 / 删除）。

**引擎** — 指纹扩展到 **19 个**（Siglus / YU-RIS / Artemis / CatSystem2 / AdvHD / SystemNNN / BGI / CMVS / Unity 等）；新增 `detectDeep()` 有限深度下钻（深度 ≤3、预算 4000 项），修子目录 `.xp3` 被判 UNKNOWN 后无法升级路由的问题。

**稳定性** — 修复 X server 输出流的静默截断与 SIGPIPE：`XOutputStream_send` 由裸阻塞 `write()` 改为 `send(MSG_NOSIGNAL)` 循环写满，EINTR 重试、EAGAIN 时 `poll` 上限 2 秒。

**工程** — box64 自建变成可复现资产（私有补丁导出 + 双向校验 + 构建脚本 + 打包器入库，版本不再写死）；类型门禁修绿（热点清单 3 → 6 条、`R` 桩 100 → 183 符号）；运行时资源 SHA-256 清单补齐 `assets` 子目录（34 → 57 个文件）。

**已知限制** — 走 DirectShow 的引擎（SystemNNN / YU-RIS 等）过场动画仍黑屏。根因已定位到 Wine 内建 quartz 的 `IVideoWindow::put_WindowStyle` → `SetWindowPos` 跨线程 `SendMessage` 永不返回（`IMediaControl::Run` 从未被调用），属 Wine 侧问题、应用层不可改，登记为 TD-09。

**真机验收** — RMX5010 / Adreno 830 / Android 16，release 包：库页 19 条正常、详情页与设置页正常、版本号显示 11.3、锚点《花瓣！》`HANA9cn.EXE` 经 UI 完整路径启动并渲染标题画面。

releases.name: NSP Box 4.0.0 — Meet NUP
releases.body:
# NSP Box 4.0.0 — Meet NUP

Smaller archives, flexible packaging, and more control over your game collection. Version 4.0 introduces **NUP Tools**, alongside the existing NSP builder.

### Package more. Store less.

- **Create compressed NUP archives** from extracted game folders, with base games, updates and DLC together in one file.
- **Choose your balance:** Fast for quicker compression, Balanced for everyday use, or Smaller for stronger compression. Incompressible files are stored raw automatically.
- **Keep what you need:** select Base, Updates and DLC independently. Choices appear after inspection, only for content present in your source. Latest-snapshot mode merges the newest selected update with the selected base, retains required base-only files, and leaves superseded versions behind. Turn it off to keep separate base/update records.
- **Avoid duplicate storage:** identical file contents can share the same space inside an archive.
- **Stay compatible:** leave files larger than 256 MiB uncompressed to reduce temporary decompression work in supported emulators.

### Convert, extract and check

- **NSP → NUP:** compress plaintext NSPs created by NSP Box.

# Switch 2 Game Packager 2.0.0

- **New Emulator patch panel:** select a Windows x64 emulator folder, check compatibility, add the patch and remove it later. Eglantine build 96 standard/PGO and PokeDinner 2.0.0 GUI/CLI profiles are recognized; matching future builds and forks can be tried experimentally without a new menu entry.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.6.1
releases.body:
This release adds a bundled driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite, brings back the audio presets that were missing from 0.6.0, fixes DLC imports and GPU hangs, lets each touch control be resized, and redesigns the launcher.

## Graphics

- **Adreno 8xx driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite.** A source-built Mesa 26.3 Turnip with a fix for the newer Qualcomm gralloc, which otherwise leaves the whole image garbled on Adreno 830. Auto selects it on SM8750 devices unless an imported driver is chosen, and it always renders with `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,nobin`. On Adreno 830 it measured about 12 ms of GPU time per frame at 100% resolution, compared with about 26 ms on the stock driver. Other Adreno 8xx GPUs can select it manually; it has only been validated on Adreno 830.
- **High refresh rate displays.** The game requests the display's fastest mode and passes the FPS option to Android, so FPS settings above 60 are no longer capped at 60 by vsync on 120 Hz phones.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.6.0
releases.body:
- Fixed DLC imports after the base game is installed, including DLC-only ZIPs/folders and ZIPs left in to_install by older builds (issue #162). Packs are hash-checked in a temporary tree before replacement; previous packs can be recovered after an interrupted replacement.
- Accepted HMM JSON schemas with trailing commas, comments and a UTF-8 BOM; schema errors no longer dump the complete file (issue #93).
- Added a persisted game-storage choice for internal memory, app folders and Android/media folders on mounted volumes, including SD cards. Optional verified copying keeps the original game, mods, settings and saves (issue #90).
- Added missing translations in English, Russian, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese and Portuguese, including mod settings, updates, storage selection and localized file/installer errors.
- Fixed overlapping guest memory copies with `memmove`, addressing the ring crash and broken collision triggers (PR #158 fix by [puopg (Michael Chen)](https://github.com/puopg)).
- Removed the earlier small-block quarantine and collision repair workarounds alongside that fix (PR #158).

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.3
releases.body:
small update

### Vulkan driver profiles

- Added **Adreno 8xx Experimental (sysmem+flushall)** as a separate, non-default launcher choice.
- The new profile uses the bundled whitebelyash Mesa 26.2 gen8-capable driver and forces the exact `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,flushall` workaround for artifact-prone Adreno 8xx devices.

### Android audio presets

- Added an experimental **POCO F8 Ultra (low latency)** preset. It reduces the internal FIFO cushion from 16 to 8 guest audio frames (about 85 ms to 43 ms) and requests AAudio's exclusive low-latency path to avoid HyperOS selecting an approximately 80 ms shared hardware burst.
- The existing **Default** and **AYN** behavior is unchanged. The POCO-specific path is opt-in because it may crackle, stall or lose sound on devices whose AAudio/MMAP implementation is unreliable.
- The selected preset, resolved FIFO parameters, AAudio performance/sharing modes, hardware burst, active buffer and platform xrun count are written to the Android log.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.2
releases.body:
### The fix for freezing and crashing on some devices (handhelds like AYN and some Android 13 phones) is still on development. We'll release it as soon as possible

Version 0.5.2 replaces the withdrawn 0.5.1 APK. It includes every user-facing change from 0.5.1, removes performance instrumentation that was unintentionally left enabled there, and adds the following.

### Mod settings (issue #75)

- Mods with an HMM `ConfigSchemaFile` now have their own settings button.
- Boolean, string, integer, floating-point and custom-enum fields are supported, including descriptions, defaults and numeric limits.
- Settings are saved atomically to the mod's INI without discarding unrelated sections, keys or comments.

### In-app updates (issue #83)

- Added periodic update checks and a manual **Check for updates** button.
- The launcher shows release notes and download progress, verifies GitHub's SHA-256 digest when present, and rejects APKs with a different package name or Android signing certificate.
- Installation is handed to Android's system installer; game files, saves, mods and settings stay in place.

### ISO / update / DLC installation (PR #78)

# 🛡️ [MOD] Exiled Kingdoms LAN Multiplayer — 2.0!

Hey everyone! Another update to the **LAN Multiplayer** mod for Exiled Kingdoms.

- **Problem:** When entering some cities, the game would crash and close.

### 🐛 Bug: Monsters ignored the CLIENT when the HOST was far away
- **Problem:** Monsters only attacked when the HOST was nearby. If only the CLIENT approached, the monster would remain still.
- **Fix:** Detection now compares the HOST and all CLIENTs present on the same map and returns the **closest** to the monster as the target.

### 🐛 Bug: Incorrect monster level scaling in co-op
- **Problem:** Monsters scaled based on 0+ (extra players). × 2), resulting in level 2 Goblins in a session with 2
- **Correction:** Now uses the Bestiary's `minlevel` as a base before applying the LAN difficulty multiplier. Example: Goblin (base level 4) + 2 players = level 6. Yeti (base level 18) + 2 players = level 22.

### 🐛 Bug: CLIENT couldn't reduce HOST's HP in the PVP Arena

releases.body:
## Changes since build 341

Built from nx2 at 7e2316d429. It includes everything testers ran in all-in-one builds 11, 13 and 14, plus the fixes that landed after them.

### Big points
- **A third GPU thread.** Eligible Switch 2 Vulkan draws are now recorded on a third thread, ported from Fritchii (Frizti). It's always on (#2319). GPU submits are lighter (#2312), and the GPU threads sleep instead of spinning while they wait (#2237, #2247).
- **Switch 2 Editions run as Switch 2.** Kirby and the Forgotten Land, Xenoblade Chronicles 2 / DE / X, Mario Wonder, Metroid Prime 4 and other Editions boot with their Switch 2 identity. Matching upgrade packs layer correctly over the game, and launches work from a .nup, a loose folder or a packed update (#2328, #2329, #2332, #2338, #2340). Bundled NUP updates show in Add-Ons (#2326). Xenoblade 2 gets its Switch 2 memory layout (#2327).
- **Switch 2 games in HOME without installing.** Games in your game folders appear in the native HOME Menu, with your custom artwork, and boot in their own session (#2148). There's also a HOME Button hotkey, and native HOME keeps its own isolated system data (#2183–#2201).

releases.name: Lichii nx2 build 341 (9c9a1df)
releases.body:
## Changes since build 316

Built from the all-in-one test build 10 (test/all-in-one-10 at 9c9a1dfa56), which testers and the maintainer ran before release: nx2 6b34d6ee13 plus every fix that was waiting for testers. These fixes are landing in nx2 now.

### Big points
- **Far fewer shader freezes, in every game.** Async shaders are now on by default with a short 8 ms wait (Bounded); choices you set yourself are kept (#2105). Compute shaders that are still compiling no longer stall the game when the screen already has an earlier result (#2104). On NVIDIA, compute shaders compile much faster (#2103), and a shader the game is waiting on no longer queues behind other builds (#2098). The pipeline cache is written safely, and a cache the driver rejects starts fresh (#2100). The second launch of the same build is almost freeze-free.
- **Cyberpunk 2077:** all 64 shaders that were rejected now translate (NVN2 root tables, surface atomics, TLD.B.LL/TXQ, USHF/REDUX/LDG) (#2089, #2090, #2093, #2094).

# WinXclipse v0.9.1

This is an incremental update to WinXclipse v0.9 focused on Community Configs, Wine input and shortcut reliability, x86/x86_64 and 32-bit compatibility, smoother Wine navigation, and safer DXVK/VKD3D setup.

# What Changed Compared to v0.9

### Community Configs

- Added a Community Configs catalog backed by the dedicated GitHub release.
- Config ZIPs download automatically; users do not need to download or keep the ZIP manually.
- Added fallback through the public release-assets page, a saved catalog index, and validated offline cache when the GitHub API is unavailable or rate-limited.
- Added toolbar search by game name.
- On the first visit, a one-time AMOLED dialog explains how to export and submit tested configs and opens the project Discord directly.
- Equivalent names are grouped regardless of case, trailing spaces, punctuation, or Arabic/Roman sequel numbers through X.
- Every matching config is checked for an embedded cover before browser artwork is requested.
- Community covers can be replaced manually.

# WinXclipse v0.9.6

## Reinstall required: back up first

**The APK signing key changed. If you are using the old key, including the original 0.9.5, you must uninstall the old APK and reinstall this version. Uninstalling deletes the app's private data.**

Before uninstalling, export your **saves and full containers**, and back up settings and control presets. Verify the backups and copy them to shared storage or a computer, outside the app's private folders. A community configuration ZIP is not a full container/save backup. Restore your backups after installing the new APK.

Recent local 0.9.6 builds already use this key and do not require this migration.

## Highlights

- Vulkan compositor, optional DisplayX, more video controls and configurable OpenGL drivers.
- Faster Wine/Proton preparation, working installation progress and corrected runtime downloads.
- Reworked sidebar, aligned switches, rounded controls and editable defaults for new containers.
- Expanded HUD with consistent RAM readings, temperatures, swap and power measurements.
- Improved FSR, file transfers, physical mouse/keyboard input and stability.
